lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense array of high-luminance circular spots arranged in at least five staggered horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a quasi-orthogonal grid pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible dorsal fin exhibits a cluster of approximately 8 to 12 high-luminance spots distributed across its surface, with higher density observed toward the anterior base.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, dark silhouettes consistent with commensal remoras attached to the ventral region below the pectoral fin.
